name: Recall report

This is the most useful issue you can file while Citetrail is pre-1.0.

**What were you trying to recall, and what for?**

**Did you get it?** (found / wrong result / nothing / blocked by your own rules)

**Was the provenance useful — did you open the original?**

**Was an agent involved, and did it cite the source correctly?**

**Would you rely on this again next week?**
